nodes.description: uint256 private _total = 1700000, initial supply constant of Passive_Income_Bot.
uint256 private _totalSupply in ERC20, mutated by _mint and _burn.
mapping(address => uint256) private _balances in ERC20.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances in ERC20.
address private _owner in Ownable, controls onlyOwner functions.
uint8 private _decimals in ERC20, set to 18 in constructor.
string private _name in ERC20.
string private _symbol in ERC20.
Passive_Income_Bot constructor: mints _total * 10**18 tokens to msg.sender.
ERC20 constructor setting _name, _symbol and _decimals.
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal: increases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal: moves balances.
ERC20.transfer public entry point calling _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
ERC20.transferFrom public entry point calling _transfer and _approve.
ERC20.approve public entry point calling _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
ERC20.increaseAllowance public function updating allowance via add then _approve.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance public function updating allowance via sub then _approve.
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal: writes _allowances.
ERC20._burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal: reduces balance and total supply.
Ownable.renounceOwnership guarded by onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner, sets _owner = newOwner.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Ownable.owner() view returning _owner.
ERC20.balanceOf(address account) view returning _balances[account].
ERC20.totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for minting and access control.
State-changing external effect: _mint(msg.sender, _total.mul(10 ** 18)) executed in the constructor.
Arithmetic operation _total.mul(10 ** 18) computing the initial mint amount (SafeMath checked multiplication).
Privileged state write _owner = msgSender (and _owner = newOwner / address(0)) controlling contract ownership.
string memory name_ constructor parameter of ERC20.
string memory symbol_ constructor parameter of ERC20.
address sender parameter of _transfer.
address recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer.
address msgSender local variable in the Ownable constructor derived from _msgSender().
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address account parameter of _mint.
uint256 amount parameter of _mint.
address spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: Passive_Income_Bot constructor invokes the internal _mint function.
Constructor performs the state-changing mint call.
The mint amount is computed from the _total state variable via multiplication by 10**18.
The multiplied value is passed as the amount argument to _mint.
msg.sender is the recipient of the initial mint performed in the constructor.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_mint credits _balances[account] by the minted amount.
ERC20 constructor assigns the token name.
ERC20 constructor assigns the token symbol.
ERC20 constructor sets _decimals to 18.
name_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor.
transfer calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom calls _transfer with the supplied sender.
transferFrom calls _approve to deduct the spent allowance.
approve calls _approve for _msgSender().
increaseAllowance adds to the allowance before calling _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the allowance before calling _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer debits and credits _balances with SafeMath checks.
_burn subtracts from _balances[account].
_burn subtracts from _totalSupply.
sender parameter feeds the _transfer balance updates.
recipient parameter feeds the _transfer balance updates.
amount parameter feeds the _transfer arithmetic.
account parameter is the mint recipient.
amount parameter is the minted quantity.
spender parameter flows into approve.
addedValue parameter flows into increaseAllowance arithmetic.
subtractedValue parameter flows into decreaseAllowance arithmetic.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debit source.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the allowance spender.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender which is stored in the local msgSender variable.
The local msgSender variable becomes the initial owner through the privileged assignment.
Ownership assignment writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for authorization.
onlyOwner compares _owner against msg.sender.
renounceOwnership resets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership reassigns _owner to newOwner.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: Local caching _msgSender() and directly assigned into the privileged _owner state variable.
